title: C4OS Grill Question 004 - Plugin Instance Scope

questions.label: What is the default state scope for tool-view plugins?
questions.help: Recommended: per chat session, with plugin-specific persistence. This matches Browser/Terminal per-session behavior while allowing Settings/config to stay global.

questions.label: Can the same plugin have multiple instances in one chat session?
questions.help: Recommended: one instance per plugin per chat session for v1. Multiple different plugins can support the same tool, but one plugin should not multiply itself until there is a concrete workflow.
